descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S12 AI Check 1: no exam dictated gives 'not examined / not documented', not a normal exam (Nursing Home, 5 of the 10), plus a one-finding boundary

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 AI Check 1: an encounter dictated with no physical exam findings gives an exam section that says not examined / not documented, never a fabricated normal exam. … (UAT TC-14 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home notes have no signature or date line (PR #57) and never say 'yesterday'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Five Nursing Home visits with history and plan but zero exam findings; one more (N-26) with a single dictated finding

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with the patient context the Nursing Home client builds

Then The exam part says not examined / not documented / Not dictated, with no undictated finding or normal

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): As S11 (shared stock-normal list, flagOverMs record-only, provisional against TFA-94229 AC 2 / Q19); the zero-exam fixtures count toward the 9/10 of S11 + S12. The Nursing Home templates have no physical-exam section and write 'Not dictated.' in every other undictated section, so a whole-note 'not dictated' proves nothing: the check is scoped to an exam section or an exam line …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
